27889.commentary: (THIa) janamajjhe'r'iva rupparūpakan'ti māyākārena mahājanamajjhe dassitaṃ rūpiyarūpasadisaṃ sāraṃ viya upaṭṭhahantaṃ, asāran'ti attho.

examples.text: māyaṃ viya aggato kataṃ, supin'ante'va suvaṇṇapādapaṃ, upagacchasi andha rittakaṃ, janamajjhe'r'iva rupparūpakaṃ.
micchājīvañ'ca avassaji samena vuttiṃ, sucinā so janayittha dhammikena, ahitam'api ca apanudi, hitam'api ca bahujanasukhañ'ca acari.

27894.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of janalapanattha
27894.meaningLit: for the sake of chatting people up
27894.construction:
jana + lapana + attha + aṃ
janalapanattha + aṃ

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti.

27899.meaning2: crowded with people, filled with people
